controls.title: Brightness

controls.title: Color preset

controls.title: Night light

controls.title: Scale
controls.reason: Lists sizes Hyprland keeps exact. Auto lets Hyprland decide from the pixel density.

controls.title: Resolution
controls.reason: Use the preferred mode or enter X and Y in pixels. Custom sizes snap to the nearest mode reported by the display.

controls.title: Refresh rate

controls.title: Orientation

controls.title: Multiple displays

controls.title: SDR saturation in HDR

controls.title: SDR minimum luminance
controls.reason: Black level used when mapping SDR to HDR, in nits.

controls.title: SDR maximum luminance
controls.reason: White level used when mapping SDR to HDR, in nits.

controls.title: Display minimum luminance
controls.reason: Overrides the reported minimum, in nits. -1 uses the reported value.

controls.title: Display peak luminance
controls.reason: Overrides the reported peak, in nits. -1 uses the reported value.

controls.title: Display average luminance
controls.reason: Overrides the reported maximum average, in nits. -1 uses the reported value.

controls.title: HDR capability
controls.reason: Override what the display reports. Forcing it on can produce a wrong picture.

controls.title: Wide color capability
controls.reason: Override what the display reports. Forcing it on can produce a wrong picture.

controls.title: ICC profile
controls.reason: Absolute path to a profile. Clearing it applies after the next Hyprland configuration reload.

controls.title: Reserved area
controls.reason: Space kept free of tiled windows, as four numbers: top right bottom left.
